package main

import (
	"fmt"
	tspack "github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack/packages/go"

func main() {
	config := tspack.ProcessConfig{
		Language: `netlinx`,
	}
	result, err := tspack.Process(`PROGRAM_NAME='hello'`, config)
